title: Working with more than one company
summary: Switch between the companies you have access to, or create a new one, from Global Config.

steps.text: On {title} in Global Config, pick a company from the list to switch to it, or use {new} to start another one from scratch.
{clients} opens a separate list for an accountant or bookkeeper working across several companies, showing what needs attention in each one.
{clients} lists every company you can open, with its accountant sync and what needs attention. Use {search} to find one, or {move} to move a company to another firm.
You can also ask the assistant which companies you can open, or for the companies your firm looks after and how each one stands.
